notes.title: New Puzzle Game VirtuGO powered by SurrealVR!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23959126/3f12b25eb672badd2fb05d6cbb04dc217f9a82f2.jpg[/img]

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/699990/VirtuGO/] New Puzzle Game VIRTUGO with VR support[/url]

Powered by SurrealVR

VirtuGO is a classic puzzle game. Colored tiles come at you nonstop, and you must put them on your carrying platform and arrange them as best you can on a 5x5 grid.

Try it now! You will love it!

notes.title: TBS Vendetta Racing Drone Giveaway!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the launch of Arena, we’ll be giving away a TBS Vendetta Racing Drone Bundle, a $1,000 value, ready to fly!  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29709084/8882aab35a91db35ec8e49d026377837dc12b434.jpg[/img]

To win it, you’ll have to be the first player to reach Drone Killer, the highest achievement level in Arena, so get out there and start decimating your opponents!

You can read the detailed information and rules [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/655200/discussions/0/1470841715938300201/] HERE[/url]
